note: Researched 6 Oct 2026. Status labels: 'official 2026' = on an official 2026 page; 'latest year only (2025)' = only last year's dates found; 'NOT VERIFIED' = not confirmed on an official page. The City of Strasbourg Christmas site (noel.strasbourg.eu) showed on 5-6 Oct 2026 only the opening date (Friday 27 November 2026), no end date, no theme, no tree-lighting date.
calendar_note: 24 Dec 2026 is a Thursday. 25 Dec is a Friday. 26 Dec is a Saturday and is a public holiday in Alsace-Moselle (St Stephen's Day). 27 Dec is a Sunday. 31 Dec is a Thursday and 1 Jan 2027 is a Friday. 27 Nov 2026 (opening) is a Friday.

sights.item: Astronomical clock: show time and price
sights.detail: Cathedral parish site: 'The astronomical clock show will not take place for the whole time of the Christmas market.' Outside the market it runs daily at 12:30 sharp (bell, then Procession of the Apostles). Tickets EUR 4 per person, EUR 3 for groups of 12 or more and students up to 25, EUR 2 for children 6 to 17, free under 6. Sold 10:00 to 11:00 at the Cathedral shops and from 11:30 at the Place Saint-Michel entrance (access from Place du Chateau). Card accepted. The City page still shows an older EUR 2 / 1.50 price, which conflicts; we use the cathedral's own page.

sights.item: Cathedral platform climb: price, hours, closures
sights.detail: 330 steps to 66 m. 1 Oct to 31 Mar: 10:00 to 13:00 and 13:30 to 18:00, last climb 17:15 (cathedral site). Strasbourg Tourisme: adult EUR 10, children EUR 6; closed 1 Jan, 1 May and 25 Dec. Good fitness needed, no access for reduced mobility, minors must be accompanied, access check at the door, no large bags or luggage (no left luggage), no food, drink or glass, no toilets (public toilets Place du Chateau), can close when 100 people are on the circuit. Another site quotes EUR 8, which conflicts; we use the tourist office figure.
Adult EUR 10, children EUR 6, schools EUR 3. Closed 01/01, 01/05 and 25/12.

The City lists the Musee Alsacien as closed for works from 7 July 2025 to 1 June 2028 (the museums home page says reopening is planned for 2028). It is NOT open at Christmas 2026. Do not recommend it. Alternatives: Musee Historique, Musee des Beaux-Arts, Musee de l'Oeuvre Notre-Dame.

sights.item: Day trip train: Strasbourg to Colmar
sights.detail: TER takes about 32 minutes, 34 daily return trips, up to 3 trains an hour; in the day departures from Strasbourg at about :21 and :51 past the hour (SNCF TER page). Fare: Carte Fluo (reduction card) EUR 7.90 per trip; standard fare NOT VERIFIED on the page. SNCF Connect shows tickets 'from EUR 6.00' (advance fare, indicative only).
In Alsace-Moselle, 26 December (St Stephen's Day) is a public holiday on top of the national holidays. 26 Dec 2026 is a Saturday.
